take your time

Hey gurl,

I know saying sorry isn't going to magically fix everything. And you know me, I don't really believe ki baar baar sorry bolne se everything becomes okay.

But I still wanted to say something, just not in the usual way.

I've thought a lot about our argument and the things I said. Main gusse mein tha, but that doesn't justify how I behaved. Tumhe hurt karna was wrong, and I genuinely regret it.

And one thing you said has stayed with me... when you said that you used to feel safe with me. I don't know why, but that really got to me. Shayad isliye because I never wanted you to feel hurt because of me.

Then I started thinking about how randomly all this started.

Allen ke first day pe meri first conversation tumse literally ye thi ki “is this row for girls?” You said I could sit there and I still went somewhere else. I still don't know why I did that.

And somehow that stupid little conversation turned into so many memories. Somewhere along the way I became Mr. Oreo — and honestly, I still find it funny how we went from that awkward first conversation to knowing each other this much.

I'm not expecting you to forget everything or forgive me immediately. Mujhe pata hai ek message se sab kuch normal nahi ho jayega.

I just wanted you to know that I understand where I went wrong, and I genuinely care about you.

one more thing

I recorded something.

Sunn ke jaana. That's all. ♫
